Class PlayingRoom

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.rooms.Room
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.rooms.PlayingRoom
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, VirtualGameServer, Serializable, Remote
public class PlayingRoom extends Room implements VirtualGameServer
The PlayingRoom class represents a game room where an active match is currently taking place. It encapsulates the main Game instance and handles the initialization of the MVC architecture (connecting the model, views, and controllers for each player). Unlike a waiting room, a playing room restricts new players from entering and retains player references upon disconnection to allow for seamless reconnections.

  • Constructor Details

    • PlayingRoom

      public PlayingRoom(ServerMultiplexer server, Hall hall, String roomName, int maxNumOfPlayers)
      Constructs a new, empty PlayingRoom. Note: This constructor is generally not used since a playing room is typically born from a populated waiting room.
      Parameters:
      server - the main server multiplexer managing the connections.
      hall - the main hall that spawned this room.
      roomName - the unique identifier/name of this room.
      maxNumOfPlayers - the maximum capacity of the room.

    • PlayingRoom

      public PlayingRoom(ServerMultiplexer server, Hall hall, String roomName, int maxNumOfPlayers, List<PhasedProxyPlayer> players)
      Constructs a PlayingRoom pre-filled with an existing list of players. This is the standard constructor used when converting a WaitingRoom into a PlayingRoom.
      Parameters:
      server - the main server multiplexer managing the connections.
      hall - the main hall that spawned this room.
      roomName - the unique identifier/name of this room.
      maxNumOfPlayers - the maximum capacity of the room.
      players - the list of players who are part of this game.

  • Method Details

    • createGame

      public void createGame() throws Exception
      Initializes the game logic, instantiates the controllers, and wires the MVC architecture. For each connected player, it creates a MassiWuPeppeController, binds it to the game model, updates the player's application phase to GAME, and assigns the necessary server adapters. If a player disconnects during this delicate phase, they are forcefully disconnected.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the creation of the game or the network transmission.

    • runGame

      public void runGame()
      Starts the main loop of the game. This method blocks until the game finishes, so it should normally be executed in its own dedicated thread to prevent blocking the main server threads.

      public Game getGame()

    • enterPlayer

      public void enterPlayer(PhasedProxyPlayer newPlayer) throws Exception
      Prevents new players from entering a game that has already started. Since canEnter() always returns false for a PlayingRoom, this method will invariably throw a RuntimeException unless specifically bypassed.
      Overrides:
      enterPlayer in class Room
      Parameters:
      newPlayer - the PhasedProxyPlayer attempting to enter.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - indicating that the room is closed for new entries.
      Exception - if a network error occurs (though highly unlikely due to the block).

    • sendCommand

      public void sendCommand(CommandPacket commandPacket) throws Exception
      Intercepts a generic command packet sent by a client. In the context of a PlayingRoom, in-game commands are typically routed directly to the player's specific controller rather than being handled by the room itself.
      Specified by:
      sendCommand in interface VirtualGameServer
      Parameters:
      commandPacket - the packet containing the command payload.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs while processing the command.

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect(DisconnectPacket disconnectPacket) throws Exception
      Handles the network disconnection of a player during an active game. Unlike the waiting room, a playing room deliberately does NOT remove the player's reference from the server or the room. This allows the disconnected player to rejoin and seamlessly resume their game session later.
      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface Disconnectable
      Parameters:
      disconnectPacket - the packet containing the disconnection details.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an unexpected error occurs.
